<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-1", "appendix": ".cluster/README_sources.md", "bytes": 10177, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": ".cluster/s01_execute.py", "sha256": "4464f18c96db45c180651c280b8a8ed24d50976b347925e39fce6a3d55f8c3ab"} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute one reviewed stage with process-tree resource and progress guards."""

import argparse
import errno
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def digest(path):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            result.update(chunk)
    return result.hexdigest()


def atomic_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + ".", dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
            stream.write("\n")
        os.replace(name, str(path))
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(name):
            os.unlink(name)


def owned(root, relative):
    path = Path(relative)
    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:
        raise ValueError("unsafe relative path")
    path = (root / path).resolve()
    if root not in path.parents:
        raise ValueError("path escapes this calculation")
    return path


def tree_rss(pid):
    output = subprocess.check_output(["ps", "-e", "-o", "pid=", "-o", "ppid=", "-o", "rss="],
                                     universal_newlines=True, timeout=20)
    rows = [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in output.splitlines()
            if len(line.split()) == 3]
    descendants = {pid}
    while True:
        expanded = descendants | {p for p, parent, _ in rows if parent in descendants}
        if expanded == descendants:
            break
        descendants = expanded
    measured = {p: rss * 1024 for p, _, rss in rows if p in descendants}
    # Some compute-node ps builds report zero RSS. Read procfs as well.
    page_bytes = os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE")
    for process in descendants:
        directory = Path("/proc") / str(process)
        try:
            status = directory.joinpath("status").read_text()
            values = [int(line.split()[1]) * 1024 for line in status.splitlines()
                      if line.startswith("VmRSS:")]
            if values:
                measured[process] = max(measured.get(process, 0), values[0])
            statm = directory.joinpath("statm").read_text().split()
            if len(statm) >= 2:
                measured[process] = max(measured.get(process, 0), int(statm[1]) * page_bytes)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            pass
    return sum(measured.values())


def disk_bytes(root):
    size = 0
    for directory, _, names in os.walk(str(root), followlinks=False):
        for name in names:
            path = Path(directory) / name
            try:
                if not path.is_symlink():
                    size += path.stat().st_size
            except OSError as error:
                if error.errno not in (errno.ENOENT, errno.ESTALE):
                    raise
                # Concurrent cache removal may invalidate an NFS directory entry.
                # The next scan counts any path that still exists.
                continue
    return size


def stop(child):
    if child.poll() is not None:
        return
    try:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        child.wait(timeout=15)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        child.wait(timeout=15)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        child.wait(timeout=15)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--job", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    if not os.environ.get("JOB_ID") or socket.gethostname().startswith("login"):
        raise RuntimeError("compute allocation required")
    job_path = owned(root, args.job)
    job = json.loads(job_path.read_text())
    for relative, expected in job["reviewed_sha256"].items():
        if digest(owned(root, relative)) != expected:
            raise RuntimeError("reviewed source/input changed: " + relative)
    result_path = owned(root, job["execution_result"])
    if result_path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("execution receipt exists; use a new job generation")
    log_path = owned(root, job["log"])
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    heartbeat = owned(root, job["heartbeat"])
    command = [token.replace("{root}", str(root)) for token in job["command"]]
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.update({"OMP_NUM_THREADS": "1", "MKL_NUM_THREADS": "1",
                "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "1", "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8"})
    env.update({key: value.replace("{root}", str(root))
                for key, value in job.get("environment", {}).items()})
    limits = job["limits"]
    started = time.monotonic()
    last_progress = started
    last_size = 0
    peak_rss = 0
    reason = "normal_exit"
    requested_limits = {
        resource.RLIMIT_AS: limits["per_process_address_bytes"],
        resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE: limits["per_file_bytes"],
        resource.RLIMIT_CORE: 0,
    }
    effective_limits = {}
    inherited_limits = {}
    for kind, requested in requested_limits.items():
        soft, hard = resource.getrlimit(kind)
        inherited_limits[kind] = [soft, hard]
        effective_limits[kind] = requested if hard == resource.RLIM_INFINITY else min(requested, hard)

    def set_limits():
        for kind, maximum in effective_limits.items():
            resource.setrlimit(kind, (maximum, maximum))

    with log_path.open("w") as output:
        try:
            child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=str(root), env=env, stdout=output,
                                     stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
                                     preexec_fn=set_limits)
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            receipt = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-execution-v1", "passed": False,
                       "reason": "program_start_failed", "error": str(error),
                       "command": command, "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"],
                       "node": socket.gethostname(), "reviewed_sha256": job["reviewed_sha256"],
                       "job_configuration_sha256": digest(job_path),
                       "inherited_resource_limits": inherited_limits,
                       "effective_resource_limits": effective_limits,
                       "completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
            atomic_json(result_path, receipt)
            print("FAIL: program_start", json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
            raise SystemExit(2)
        print("PROCESS_STARTED", child.pid, flush=True)
        try:
            while child.poll() is None:
                now = time.monotonic()
                rss = tree_rss(child.pid)
                peak_rss = max(peak_rss, rss)
                size = log_path.stat().st_size
                if size != last_size:
                    last_progress, last_size = now, size
                scratch_bytes = disk_bytes(root)
                state = {"pid": child.pid, "rss_bytes": rss,
                         "peak_tree_rss_bytes": peak_rss,
                         "elapsed_seconds": now - started,
                         "inactive_seconds": now - last_progress,
                         "scratch_bytes": scratch_bytes,
                         "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"], "log_bytes": size}
                atomic_json(heartbeat, state)
                if rss > limits["tree_rss_bytes"]:
                    reason = "tree_rss_limit"
                elif rss == 0 and peak_rss == 0 and now - started > 15:
                    reason = "rss_measurement_unavailable"
                elif now - started > limits["wall_seconds"]:
                    reason = "wall_limit"
                elif now - last_progress > limits["inactivity_seconds"]:
                    reason = "inactivity_limit"
                elif scratch_bytes > limits["scratch_bytes"]:
                    reason = "scratch_limit"
                elif shutil.disk_usage(str(root)).free < limits["disk_reserve_bytes"]:
                    reason = "disk_reserve"
                if reason != "normal_exit":
                    stop(child)
                    break
                time.sleep(limits["poll_seconds"])
        except BaseException:
            stop(child)
            raise
        code = child.wait()
    passed_marker = False
    failed_marker = False
    with log_path.open(errors="replace") as stream:
        for line in stream:
            passed_marker = passed_marker or job["success_marker"] in line
            failed_marker = failed_marker or "FAIL:" in line
    expected = [owned(root, path) for path in job["expected_results"]]
    passed = (code == 0 and reason == "normal_exit" and passed_marker
              and not failed_marker and all(path.is_file() for path in expected))
    receipt = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-execution-v1", "passed": passed,
               "exit_code": code, "reason": reason, "command": command,
               "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"], "node": socket.gethostname(),
               "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
               "peak_observed_tree_rss_bytes": peak_rss,
               "child_maxrss_bytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss * 1024,
               "reviewed_sha256": job["reviewed_sha256"],
               "inherited_resource_limits": inherited_limits,
               "effective_resource_limits": effective_limits,
               "job_configuration_sha256": digest(job_path),
               "result_sha256": {str(path.relative_to(root)): digest(path)
                                 for path in expected if path.is_file()},
               "completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    atomic_json(result_path, receipt)
    print("JOB_FINISHED", json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

            resource.setrlimit(kind, (maximum, maximum))

    with log_path.open("w") as output:
        try:
            child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=str(root), env=env, stdout=output,
                                     stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
                                     preexec_fn=set_limits)
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            receipt = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-execution-v1", "passed": False,
                       "reason": "program_start_failed", "error": str(error),
                       "command": command, "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"],
                       "node": socket.gethostname(), "reviewed_sha256": job["reviewed_sha256"],
                       "job_configuration_sha256": digest(job_path),
                       "inherited_resource_limits": inherited_limits,
                       "effective_resource_limits": effective_limits,
                       "completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
            atomic_json(result_path, receipt)
            print("FAIL: program_start", json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
            raise SystemExit(2)
        print("PROCESS_STARTED", child.pid, flush=True)
        try:
            while child.poll() is None:
                now = time.monotonic()
                rss = tree_rss(child.pid)
                peak_rss = max(peak_rss, rss)
                size = log_path.stat().st_size
                if size != last_size:
                    last_progress, last_size = now, size
                scratch_bytes = disk_bytes(root)
                state = {"pid": child.pid, "rss_bytes": rss,
                         "peak_tree_rss_bytes": peak_rss,
                         "elapsed_seconds": now - started,
                         "inactive_seconds": now - last_progress,
                         "scratch_bytes": scratch_bytes,
                         "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"], "log_bytes": size}
                atomic_json(heartbeat, state)
                if rss > limits["tree_rss_bytes"]:
                    reason = "tree_rss_limit"
                elif rss == 0 and peak_rss == 0 and now - started > 15:
                    reason = "rss_measurement_unavailable"
                elif now - started > limits["wall_seconds"]:
                    reason = "wall_limit"
                elif now - last_progress > limits["inactivity_seconds"]:
                    reason = "inactivity_limit"
                elif scratch_bytes > limits["scratch_bytes"]:
                    reason = "scratch_limit"
                elif shutil.disk_usage(str(root)).free < limits["disk_reserve_bytes"]:
                    reason = "disk_reserve"
                if reason != "normal_exit":
                    stop(child)
                    break
                time.sleep(limits["poll_seconds"])
        except BaseException:
            stop(child)
            raise
        code = child.wait()
    passed_marker = False
    failed_marker = False
    with log_path.open(errors="replace") as stream:
        for line in stream:
            passed_marker = passed_marker or job["success_marker"] in line
            failed_marker = failed_marker or "FAIL:" in line
    expected = [owned(root, path) for path in job["expected_results"]]
    passed = (code == 0 and reason == "normal_exit" and passed_marker
              and not failed_marker and all(path.is_file() for path in expected))
    receipt = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-execution-v1", "passed": passed,

    atomic_json(result_path, receipt)
    print("JOB_FINISHED", json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True), flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute one reviewed stage with process-tree resource and progress guards."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def digest(path):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            result.update(chunk)
    return result.hexdigest()


def atomic_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + ".", dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
            stream.write("\n")
        os.replace(name, str(path))
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(name):
            os.unlink(name)


def owned(root, relative):
    path = Path(relative)
    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:
        raise ValueError("unsafe relative path")
    path = (root / path).resolve()
    if root not in path.parents:
        raise ValueError("path escapes this calculation")
    return path


def tree_rss(pid):
    output = subprocess.check_output(["ps", "-e", "-o", "pid=", "-o", "ppid=", "-o", "rss="],
                                     universal_newlines=True, timeout=20)
    rows = [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in output.splitlines()
            if len(line.split()) == 3]
    descendants = {pid}
    while True:
        expanded = descendants | {p for p, parent, _ in rows if parent in descendants}
        if expanded == descendants:
            break
        descendants = expanded
    measured = {p: rss * 1024 for p, _, rss in rows if p in descendants}
    # Some compute-node ps builds report zero RSS. Read procfs as well.
    page_bytes = os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE")
    for process in descendants:
        directory = Path("/proc") / str(process)
        try:
            status = directory.joinpath("status").read_text()
            values = [int(line.split()[1]) * 1024 for line in status.splitlines()
                      if line.startswith("VmRSS:")]
            if values:
                measured[process] = max(measured.get(process, 0), values[0])
            statm = directory.joinpath("statm").read_text().split()
            if len(statm) >= 2:
                measured[process] = max(measured.get(process, 0), int(statm[1]) * page_bytes)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            pass
    return sum(measured.values())


def disk_bytes(root):
    size = 0
    for directory, _, names in os.walk(str(root), followlinks=False):
        for name in names:
            path = Path(directory) / name
            try:
                if not path.is_symlink():
                    size += path.stat().st_size
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
    return size


def stop(child):
    if child.poll() is not None:
        return
    try:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        child.wait(timeout=15)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        child.wait(timeout=15)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        child.wait(timeout=15)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--job", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    if not os.environ.get("JOB_ID") or socket.gethostname().startswith("login"):
        raise RuntimeError("compute allocation required")
    job_path = owned(root, args.job)
    job = json.loads(job_path.read_text())
    for relative, expected in job["reviewed_sha256"].items():
        if digest(owned(root, relative)) != expected:
            raise RuntimeError("reviewed source/input changed: " + relative)
    result_path = owned(root, job["execution_result"])
    if result_path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("execution receipt exists; use a new job generation")
    log_path = owned(root, job["log"])
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    heartbeat = owned(root, job["heartbeat"])
    command = [token.replace("{root}", str(root)) for token in job["command"]]
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.update({"OMP_NUM_THREADS": "1", "MKL_NUM_THREADS": "1",
                "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "1", "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8"})
    env.update({key: value.replace("{root}", str(root))
                for key, value in job.get("environment", {}).items()})
    limits = job["limits"]
    started = time.monotonic()
    last_progress = started
    last_size = 0
    peak_rss = 0
    reason = "normal_exit"
    requested_limits = {
        resource.RLIMIT_AS: limits["per_process_address_bytes"],
        resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE: limits["per_file_bytes"],
        resource.RLIMIT_CORE: 0,
    }
    effective_limits = {}
    inherited_limits = {}
    for kind, requested in requested_limits.items():
        soft, hard = resource.getrlimit(kind)
        inherited_limits[kind] = [soft, hard]
        effective_limits[kind] = requested if hard == resource.RLIM_INFINITY else min(requested, hard)

    def set_limits():
        for kind, maximum in effective_limits.items():
            resource.setrlimit(kind, (maximum, maximum))

    with log_path.open("w") as output:
        try:
            child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=str(root), env=env, stdout=output,
                                     stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
                                     preexec_fn=set_limits)
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            receipt = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-execution-v1", "passed": False,
                       "reason": "program_start_failed", "error": str(error),
                       "command": command, "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"],
                       "node": socket.gethostname(), "reviewed_sha256": job["reviewed_sha256"],
                       "job_configuration_sha256": digest(job_path),
                       "inherited_resource_limits": inherited_limits,
                       "effective_resource_limits": effective_limits,
                       "completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
            atomic_json(result_path, receipt)
            print("FAIL: program_start", json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
            raise SystemExit(2)
        print("PROCESS_STARTED", child.pid, flush=True)
        try:
            while child.poll() is None:
                now = time.monotonic()
                rss = tree_rss(child.pid)
                peak_rss = max(peak_rss, rss)
                size = log_path.stat().st_size
                if size != last_size:
                    last_progress, last_size = now, size
                scratch_bytes = disk_bytes(root)
                state = {"pid": child.pid, "rss_bytes": rss,
                         "peak_tree_rss_bytes": peak_rss,
                         "elapsed_seconds": now - started,
                         "inactive_seconds": now - last_progress,
                         "scratch_bytes": scratch_bytes,
                         "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"], "log_bytes": size}
                atomic_json(heartbeat, state)
                if rss > limits["tree_rss_bytes"]:
                    reason = "tree_rss_limit"
                elif rss == 0 and peak_rss == 0 and now - started > 15:
                    reason = "rss_measurement_unavailable"
                elif now - started > limits["wall_seconds"]:
                    reason = "wall_limit"
                elif now - last_progress > limits["inactivity_seconds"]:
                    reason = "inactivity_limit"
                elif scratch_bytes > limits["scratch_bytes"]:
                    reason = "scratch_limit"
                elif shutil.disk_usage(str(root)).free < limits["disk_reserve_bytes"]:
                    reason = "disk_reserve"
                if reason != "normal_exit":
                    stop(child)
                    break
                time.sleep(limits["poll_seconds"])
        except BaseException:
            stop(child)
            raise
        code = child.wait()
    passed_marker = False
    failed_marker = False
    with log_path.open(errors="replace") as stream:
        for line in stream:
            passed_marker = passed_marker or job["success_marker"] in line
            failed_marker = failed_marker or "FAIL:" in line
    expected = [owned(root, path) for path in job["expected_results"]]
    passed = (code == 0 and reason == "normal_exit" and passed_marker
              and not failed_marker and all(path.is_file() for path in expected))
    receipt = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-execution-v1", "passed": passed,
               "exit_code": code, "reason": reason, "command": command,
               "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"], "node": socket.gethostname(),
               "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
               "peak_observed_tree_rss_bytes": peak_rss,
               "child_maxrss_bytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss * 1024,
               "reviewed_sha256": job["reviewed_sha256"],
               "inherited_resource_limits": inherited_limits,
               "effective_resource_limits": effective_limits,
               "job_configuration_sha256": digest(job_path),
               "result_sha256": {str(path.relative_to(root)): digest(path)
                                 for path in expected if path.is_file()},
               "completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    atomic_json(result_path, receipt)
    print("JOB_FINISHED", json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Execute one reviewed stage with process-tree resource and progress guards."""

import argparse

import json

def digest(path):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            result.update(chunk)
    return result.hexdigest()


def atomic_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + ".", dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
            stream.write("\n")
        os.replace(name, str(path))
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(name):
            os.unlink(name)


def owned(root, relative):
    path = Path(relative)
    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:
        raise ValueError("unsafe relative path")
    path = (root / path).resolve()

def tree_rss(pid):

        expanded = descendants | {p for p, parent, _ in rows if parent in descendants}
        if expanded == descendants:
            break

def disk_bytes(root):
    size = 0

        for name in names:

def stop(child):

    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        child.wait(timeout=15)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        child.wait(timeout=15)

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)

        if digest(owned(root, relative)) != expected:

    log_path = owned(root, job["log"])
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

## .cluster/s02_execute.py

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-7", "appendix": ".cluster/README_sources.md", "bytes": 12716, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": ".cluster/s02_execute.py", "sha256": "e990f6fb14efddc603affef591c0fad7c18ba8b2b1ed152fd30f0e2ba544d6eb"} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute one reviewed stage with process-tree resource and progress guards."""

import argparse
import errno
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def digest(path):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            result.update(chunk)
    return result.hexdigest()


def atomic_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + ".", dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
            stream.write("\n")
        os.replace(name, str(path))
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(name):
            os.unlink(name)


def owned(root, relative):
    path = Path(relative)
    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:
        raise ValueError("unsafe relative path")
    path = (root / path).resolve()
    if root not in path.parents:
        raise ValueError("path escapes this calculation")
    return path


def tree_rss(pid):
    output = subprocess.check_output(["ps", "-e", "-o", "pid=", "-o", "ppid=", "-o", "rss="],
                                     universal_newlines=True, timeout=20)
    rows = [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in output.splitlines()
            if len(line.split()) == 3]
    descendants = {pid}
    while True:
        expanded = descendants | {p for p, parent, _ in rows if parent in descendants}
        if expanded == descendants:
            break
        descendants = expanded
    measured = {p: rss * 1024 for p, _, rss in rows if p in descendants}
    # Some compute-node ps builds report zero RSS. Read procfs as well.
    page_bytes = os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE")
    for process in descendants:
        directory = Path("/proc") / str(process)
        try:
            status = directory.joinpath("status").read_text()
            values = [int(line.split()[1]) * 1024 for line in status.splitlines()
                      if line.startswith("VmRSS:")]
            if values:
                measured[process] = max(measured.get(process, 0), values[0])
            statm = directory.joinpath("statm").read_text().split()
            if len(statm) >= 2:
                measured[process] = max(measured.get(process, 0), int(statm[1]) * page_bytes)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            pass
    return sum(measured.values())


def disk_bytes(root):
    size = 0
    for directory, _, names in os.walk(str(root), followlinks=False):
        for name in names:
            path = Path(directory) / name
            try:
                if not path.is_symlink():
                    size += path.stat().st_size
            except OSError as error:
                if error.errno not in (errno.ENOENT, errno.ESTALE):
                    raise
                # Concurrent cache removal may invalidate an NFS directory entry.
                # The next scan counts any path that still exists.
                continue
    return size


class StorageMonitor:
    """Sample shared storage without blocking process and memory monitoring."""

    def __init__(self, root, interval):
        self.root = root
        self.interval = interval
        self.created = time.monotonic()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.worker = None
        self.value = None
        self.error = None
        self.finished = None
        self.scan_started = None

    def _scan(self):
        try:
            value = {"scratch_bytes": disk_bytes(self.root),
                     "free_bytes": shutil.disk_usage(str(self.root)).free}
            error = None
        except Exception as exc:
            value, error = None, repr(exc)
        with self.lock:
            self.value, self.error = value, error
            self.finished = time.monotonic()

    def poll(self):
        now = time.monotonic()
        with self.lock:
            launch = ((self.worker is None or not self.worker.is_alive())
                      and (self.finished is None or now - self.finished >= self.interval))
            if launch:
                self.scan_started = now
                self.worker = threading.Thread(target=self._scan, daemon=True)
                self.worker.start()
        return self.snapshot()

    def snapshot(self):
        now = time.monotonic()
        with self.lock:
            return {"measurement": dict(self.value) if self.value is not None else None,
                    "error": self.error,
                    "scan_pending": self.worker is not None and self.worker.is_alive(),
                    "measurement_age_seconds": now - (self.finished if self.finished is not None
                                                       else self.created),
                    "scan_elapsed_seconds": (now - self.scan_started
                                             if self.scan_started is not None else None)}


def stop(child):
    if child.poll() is not None:
        return
    try:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        child.wait(timeout=15)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        child.wait(timeout=15)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        child.wait(timeout=15)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--job", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    if not os.environ.get("JOB_ID") or socket.gethostname().startswith("login"):
        raise RuntimeError("compute allocation required")
    job_path = owned(root, args.job)
    job = json.loads(job_path.read_text())
    for relative, expected in job["reviewed_sha256"].items():
        if digest(owned(root, relative)) != expected:
            raise RuntimeError("reviewed source/input changed: " + relative)
    result_path = owned(root, job["execution_result"])
    if result_path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("execution receipt exists; use a new job generation")
    log_path = owned(root, job["log"])
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    heartbeat = owned(root, job["heartbeat"])
    command = [token.replace("{root}", str(root)) for token in job["command"]]
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.update({"OMP_NUM_THREADS": "1", "MKL_NUM_THREADS": "1",
                "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "1", "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8"})
    env.update({key: value.replace("{root}", str(root))
                for key, value in job.get("environment", {}).items()})
    limits = job["limits"]
    started = time.monotonic()
    last_progress = started
    last_size = 0
    peak_rss = 0
    reason = "normal_exit"
    requested_limits = {
        resource.RLIMIT_AS: limits["per_process_address_bytes"],
        resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE: limits["per_file_bytes"],
        resource.RLIMIT_CORE: 0,
    }
    effective_limits = {}
    inherited_limits = {}
    for kind, requested in requested_limits.items():
        soft, hard = resource.getrlimit(kind)
        inherited_limits[kind] = [soft, hard]
        effective_limits[kind] = requested if hard == resource.RLIM_INFINITY else min(requested, hard)

    def set_limits():
        for kind, maximum in effective_limits.items():
            resource.setrlimit(kind, (maximum, maximum))

    with log_path.open("w") as output:
        try:
            child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=str(root), env=env, stdout=output,
                                     stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
                                     preexec_fn=set_limits)
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            receipt = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-execution-v1", "passed": False,
                       "reason": "program_start_failed", "error": str(error),
                       "command": command, "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"],
                       "node": socket.gethostname(), "reviewed_sha256": job["reviewed_sha256"],
                       "job_configuration_sha256": digest(job_path),
                       "inherited_resource_limits": inherited_limits,
                       "effective_resource_limits": effective_limits,
                       "completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
            atomic_json(result_path, receipt)
            print("FAIL: program_start", json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
            raise SystemExit(2)
        storage = StorageMonitor(root, max(60, limits["poll_seconds"]))
        print("PROCESS_STARTED", child.pid, flush=True)
        try:
            while child.poll() is None:
                now = time.monotonic()
                rss = tree_rss(child.pid)
                peak_rss = max(peak_rss, rss)
                size = log_path.stat().st_size
                if size != last_size:
                    last_progress, last_size = now, size
                storage_state = storage.poll()
                disk = storage_state["measurement"]
                scratch_bytes = disk["scratch_bytes"] if disk is not None else None
                state = {"pid": child.pid, "rss_bytes": rss,
                         "peak_tree_rss_bytes": peak_rss,
                         "elapsed_seconds": now - started,
                         "inactive_seconds": now - last_progress,
                         "scratch_bytes": scratch_bytes,
                         "storage_monitor": storage_state,
                         "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"], "log_bytes": size}
                atomic_json(heartbeat, state)
                if rss > limits["tree_rss_bytes"]:
                    reason = "tree_rss_limit"
                elif rss == 0 and peak_rss == 0 and now - started > 15:
                    reason = "rss_measurement_unavailable"
                elif now - started > limits["wall_seconds"]:
                    reason = "wall_limit"
                elif now - last_progress > limits["inactivity_seconds"]:
                    reason = "inactivity_limit"
                elif storage_state["error"] is not None:
                    reason = "storage_measurement_error"
                elif storage_state["measurement_age_seconds"] > max(300, limits["inactivity_seconds"]):
                    reason = "storage_measurement_timeout"
                elif disk is not None and disk["scratch_bytes"] > limits["scratch_bytes"]:
                    reason = "scratch_limit"
                elif disk is not None and disk["free_bytes"] < limits["disk_reserve_bytes"]:
                    reason = "disk_reserve"
                if reason != "normal_exit":
                    stop(child)
                    break
                time.sleep(limits["poll_seconds"])
        except BaseException:
            stop(child)
            raise
        code = child.wait()
    passed_marker = False
    failed_marker = False
    with log_path.open(errors="replace") as stream:
        for line in stream:
            passed_marker = passed_marker or job["success_marker"] in line
            failed_marker = failed_marker or "FAIL:" in line
    expected = [owned(root, path) for path in job["expected_results"]]
    passed = (code == 0 and reason == "normal_exit" and passed_marker
              and not failed_marker and all(path.is_file() for path in expected))
    receipt = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-execution-v1", "passed": passed,
               "exit_code": code, "reason": reason, "command": command,
               "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"], "node": socket.gethostname(),
               "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
               "peak_observed_tree_rss_bytes": peak_rss,
               "storage_monitor": storage.snapshot(),
               "child_maxrss_bytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss * 1024,
               "reviewed_sha256": job["reviewed_sha256"],
               "inherited_resource_limits": inherited_limits,
               "effective_resource_limits": effective_limits,
               "job_configuration_sha256": digest(job_path),
               "result_sha256": {str(path.relative_to(root)): digest(path)
                                 for path in expected if path.is_file()},
               "completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    atomic_json(result_path, receipt)
    print("JOB_FINISHED", json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-8", "appendix": ".cluster/README_sources.md", "bytes": 890, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": ".cluster/s02_probe_runtime.wls", "sha256": "22993dc137499eb11a435858c8a1dcbc0ac6978b4b0bc130637b1920a291def4"} -->
```wolfram
(* Read-only compute-node probe of the native script and user-base interface. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
If[!StringQ[Environment["JOB_ID"]] || StringStartsQ[$MachineName, "login"], Quit[1]];
result = <|"WolframVersion" -> $Version, "MachineName" -> $MachineName,
  "InputFileName" -> $InputFileName, "ScriptCommandLine" -> $ScriptCommandLine,
  "UserBaseDirectory" -> $UserBaseDirectory,
  "MathematicaUserBaseEnvironment" -> Environment["MATHEMATICA_USERBASE"],
  "WolframUserBaseEnvironment" -> Environment["WOLFRAM_USERBASE"],
  "WorkingDirectory" -> Directory[], "JobID" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>;
Print[InputForm[result]];
target = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], ".cluster", "s02_result", "s02_runtime.wl"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[DirectoryName[target]], CreateDirectory[DirectoryName[target], CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
Put[result, target];
Print["PASS: s02_probe_runtime"];
Quit[0];

```

## .cluster/s02_result/s02_executor.py

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-13", "appendix": ".cluster/README_sources.md", "bytes": 8971, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": ".cluster/s02_result/s02_executor.py", "sha256": "9f6e9c692595574ba72f599ef9ee40ab6971b267e2748772767c04bb9502862f"} -->
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Execute one reviewed stage with process-tree resource and progress guards."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import resource
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def digest(path):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            result.update(chunk)
    return result.hexdigest()


def atomic_json(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + ".", dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
            stream.write("\n")
        os.replace(name, str(path))
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(name):
            os.unlink(name)


def owned(root, relative):
    path = Path(relative)
    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:
        raise ValueError("unsafe relative path")
    path = (root / path).resolve()
    if root not in path.parents:
        raise ValueError("path escapes this calculation")
    return path


def tree_rss(pid):
    output = subprocess.check_output(["ps", "-eo", "pid=,ppid=,rss="],
                                     universal_newlines=True, timeout=20)
    rows = [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in output.splitlines()
            if len(line.split()) == 3]
    descendants = {pid}
    while True:
        expanded = descendants | {p for p, parent, _ in rows if parent in descendants}
        if expanded == descendants:
            break
        descendants = expanded
    return sum(rss for p, _, rss in rows if p in descendants) * 1024


def disk_bytes(root):
    size = 0
    for directory, _, names in os.walk(str(root), followlinks=False):
        for name in names:
            path = Path(directory) / name
            try:
                if not path.is_symlink():
                    size += path.stat().st_size
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
    return size


def stop(child):
    if child.poll() is not None:
        return
    try:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        child.wait(timeout=15)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        child.wait(timeout=15)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        child.wait(timeout=15)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--job", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    if not os.environ.get("JOB_ID") or socket.gethostname().startswith("login"):
        raise RuntimeError("compute allocation required")
    job_path = owned(root, args.job)
    job = json.loads(job_path.read_text())
    for relative, expected in job["reviewed_sha256"].items():
        if digest(owned(root, relative)) != expected:
            raise RuntimeError("reviewed source/input changed: " + relative)
    result_path = owned(root, job["execution_result"])
    if result_path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("execution receipt exists; use a new job generation")
    log_path = owned(root, job["log"])
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    heartbeat = owned(root, job["heartbeat"])
    command = [token.replace("{root}", str(root)) for token in job["command"]]
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.update({"OMP_NUM_THREADS": "1", "MKL_NUM_THREADS": "1",
                "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS": "1", "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8"})
    env.update({key: value.replace("{root}", str(root))
                for key, value in job.get("environment", {}).items()})
    limits = job["limits"]
    started = time.monotonic()
    last_progress = started
    last_size = 0
    peak_rss = 0
    reason = "normal_exit"
    requested_limits = {
        resource.RLIMIT_AS: limits["per_process_address_bytes"],
        resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE: limits["per_file_bytes"],
        resource.RLIMIT_CORE: 0,
    }
    effective_limits = {}
    inherited_limits = {}
    for kind, requested in requested_limits.items():
        soft, hard = resource.getrlimit(kind)
        inherited_limits[kind] = [soft, hard]
        effective_limits[kind] = requested if hard == resource.RLIM_INFINITY else min(requested, hard)

    def set_limits():
        for kind, maximum in effective_limits.items():
            resource.setrlimit(kind, (maximum, maximum))

    with log_path.open("w") as output:
        try:
            child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=str(root), env=env, stdout=output,
                                     stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
                                     preexec_fn=set_limits)
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            receipt = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-execution-v1", "passed": False,
                       "reason": "program_start_failed", "error": str(error),
                       "command": command, "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"],
                       "node": socket.gethostname(), "reviewed_sha256": job["reviewed_sha256"],
                       "job_configuration_sha256": digest(job_path),
                       "inherited_resource_limits": inherited_limits,
                       "effective_resource_limits": effective_limits,
                       "completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
            atomic_json(result_path, receipt)
            print("FAIL: program_start", json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)
            raise SystemExit(2)
        print("PROCESS_STARTED", child.pid, flush=True)
        try:
            while child.poll() is None:
                now = time.monotonic()
                rss = tree_rss(child.pid)
                peak_rss = max(peak_rss, rss)
                size = log_path.stat().st_size
                if size != last_size:
                    last_progress, last_size = now, size
                scratch_bytes = disk_bytes(root)
                state = {"pid": child.pid, "rss_bytes": rss,
                         "peak_tree_rss_bytes": peak_rss,
                         "elapsed_seconds": now - started,
                         "inactive_seconds": now - last_progress,
                         "scratch_bytes": scratch_bytes,
                         "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"], "log_bytes": size}
                atomic_json(heartbeat, state)
                if rss > limits["tree_rss_bytes"]:
                    reason = "tree_rss_limit"
                elif now - started > limits["wall_seconds"]:
                    reason = "wall_limit"
                elif now - last_progress > limits["inactivity_seconds"]:
                    reason = "inactivity_limit"
                elif scratch_bytes > limits["scratch_bytes"]:
                    reason = "scratch_limit"
                elif shutil.disk_usage(str(root)).free < limits["disk_reserve_bytes"]:
                    reason = "disk_reserve"
                if reason != "normal_exit":
                    stop(child)
                    break
                time.sleep(limits["poll_seconds"])
        except BaseException:
            stop(child)
            raise
        code = child.wait()
    passed_marker = False
    failed_marker = False
    with log_path.open(errors="replace") as stream:
        for line in stream:
            passed_marker = passed_marker or job["success_marker"] in line
            failed_marker = failed_marker or "FAIL:" in line
    expected = [owned(root, path) for path in job["expected_results"]]
    passed = (code == 0 and reason == "normal_exit" and passed_marker
              and not failed_marker and all(path.is_file() for path in expected))
    receipt = {"schema": "polarized-sidis-execution-v1", "passed": passed,
               "exit_code": code, "reason": reason, "command": command,
               "job_id": os.environ["JOB_ID"], "node": socket.gethostname(),
               "wall_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
               "peak_observed_tree_rss_bytes": peak_rss,
               "child_maxrss_bytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss * 1024,
               "reviewed_sha256": job["reviewed_sha256"],
               "inherited_resource_limits": inherited_limits,
               "effective_resource_limits": effective_limits,
               "job_configuration_sha256": digest(job_path),
               "result_sha256": {str(path.relative_to(root)): digest(path)
                                 for path in expected if path.is_file()},
               "completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}
    atomic_json(result_path, receipt)
    print("JOB_FINISHED", json.dumps(receipt, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0 if passed else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

  ],

    "MATHEMATICA_USERBASE": "{root}/cache/wolfram_s05_Hgg_zero_angular_interface",

{
  "command": [
    "python3",
    "-c",
    "from pathlib import Path\nimport os,json,hashlib,tarfile,subprocess,shutil,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET\nr=Path('/u/scratch/r/rushil/AI_Assisted_SIDIS/polarized_SIDIS_20260917T063521Z')\nc='Hgq';s='s05';prefix='cache/'+s+'/'+c+'/'\ndef digest(p):\n h=hashlib.sha256()\n with p.open('rb') as f:\n  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b)\n return h.hexdigest()\ndef active():\n rows=ET.fromstring(subprocess.check_output(['/u/systems/UGE8.6.4/bin/lx-amd64/qstat','-xml','-u','rushil'])).findall('.//job_list')\n return [(a.findtext('JB_job_number'),a.findtext('JB_name')) for a in rows if a.findtext('JB_name','').startswith('pSIDIS_') and a.findtext('JB_job_number')!=os.environ.get('JOB_ID')]\nd=r/prefix;resultdir=r/c/(s+'_result');receiptpath=resultdir/(s+'_execution.json')\nv=json.loads(receiptpath.read_text());assert v['passed'] and v['job_id']=='14795984'\nfor n,h in v['result_sha256'].items():assert digest(r/n)==h,n\nlive=active();assert not any(n.startswith('pSIDIS_'+s+'_'+c+'_') for jid,n in live)\nfor jid,n in live:\n j=json.loads((r/'.cluster'/(n[len('pSIDIS_'):]+'_job.json')).read_text())\n assert not any(p.startswith(prefix) for p in j['reviewed_sha256']),(jid,prefix)\nmp=resultdir/(s+'_cache_manifest.json')\nassert not mp.exists() and not list(resultdir.glob(s+'_cache_part*.tar.gz*'))\nfiles=sorted(p for p in d.rglob('*') if p.is_file())\nassert files and all(not p.is_symlink() and r in p.resolve().parents for p in files)\ninventory={str(p.relative_to(r)):{'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(p)} for p in files}\nrawbytes=sum(a['bytes'] for a in inventory.values())\nassert rawbytes<512*1024**2\nassert shutil.disk_usage(str(r)).free>2*1024**3+rawbytes\ngroups=[];group=[];total=0;part_limit=120*1024**2\nfor p in files:\n size=inventory[str(p.relative_to(r))]['bytes'];assert size<part_limit\n if group and total+size>part_limit:groups.append(group);group=[];total=0\n group.append(p);total+=size\nif group:groups.append(group)\nparts=[];seen=set()\nfor i,group in enumerate(groups,1):\n out=resultdir/(s+'_cache_part'+str(i).zfill(2)+'.tar.gz');temp=out.with_name(out.name+'.tmp')\n with tarfile.open(str(temp),'w:gz',compresslevel=1) as t:\n  for p in group:t.add(str(p),arcname=str(p.relative_to(r)),recursive=False)\n assert temp.stat().st_size<128*1024**2\n with tarfile.open(str(temp),'r:gz') as t:\n  for member in t:\n   assert member.isfile() and member.name in inventory and member.name not in seen\n   h=hashlib.sha256();n=0\n   with t.extractfile(member) as f:\n    for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b);n+=len(b)\n   assert n==inventory[member.name]['bytes'] and h.hexdigest()==inventory[member.name]['sha256']\n   seen.add(member.name);inventory[member.name]['archive']=str(out.relative_to(r))\n temp.rename(out)\n parts.append({'file':str(out.relative_to(r)),'bytes':out.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(out)})\nassert seen==set(inventory)\nfor p in files:assert digest(p)==inventory[str(p.relative_to(r))]['sha256']\nassert not any(n.startswith('pSIDIS_'+s+'_'+c+'_') for jid,n in active())\nmanifest={'schema':'polarized-sidis-lossless-cache-archive-parts-v1','channel':c,'stage':s,'accepted_job_id':v['job_id'],'accepted_execution_sha256':digest(receiptpath),'accepted_result_sha256':v['result_sha256'],'archives':parts,'logical_bytes':rawbytes,'files':inventory,'member_hashes_verified':True,'restore_base':str(r)}\nmp.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+chr(10))\nfor p in files:p.unlink()\nfor p in sorted([p for p in d.rglob('*') if p.is_dir()],key=lambda p:len(p.parts),reverse=True):\n try:p.rmdir()\n except OSError:pass\noutputs={a['file']:a['sha256'] for a in parts};outputs[str(mp.relative_to(r))]=digest(mp)\nprint(json.dumps({'event':'ARCHIVED_COMPLETED_STAGE_CACHE','channel':c,'stage':s,'accepted_job_id':v['job_id'],'logical_bytes':rawbytes,'archives':parts,'files':outputs,'manifest':str(mp.relative_to(r))}),flush=True)\n"

r.name=='polarized_SIDIS_20260917T063521Z'\ncache=r/'cache/s05/Hgq/30e6c27f9a81001780d464a775c580df63a6245bbaf65b36be5de49f814a936b'\nout=r/'Hgq/s05_projection_archive_result';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\nmanifestpath=out/'s05_cache_manifest.json'\nassert not manifestpath.exists() and not list(out.glob('s05_cache_part*.tar.gz*'))\ndef digest(p):\n h=hashlib.sha256()\n with p.open('rb') as f:\n  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b)\n return h.hexdigest()\ndef atomic(p,v):\n tmp=p.with_name(p.name+'.tmp');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\\n');tmp.replace(p)\ndef strings(v):\n if isinstance(v,str):yield v\n elif isinstance(v,dict):\n  for k,w in v.items():\n   yield k\n   for s in strings(w):yield s\n elif isinstance(v,list):\n  for w in v:\n   for s in strings(w):yield s\ndef protected_paths():\n protected={str((cache/'Real_1_5_P2_2.wl').relative_to(r))}\n for p in list((r/'common').glob('s05*.json'))+list((r/'.cluster').glob('*_job.json')):\n  for s in strings(json.loads(p.read_text())):\n   if s.startswith('cache/s05/Hgq/'):protected.add(s)\n return protected\nprotected=protected_paths()\npairs=sorted(p for p in cache.glob('Real*.wl') if re.fullmatch(r'Real[^_]*_[0-9]+_[0-9]+\\.wl',p.name))\nassert pairs\npairhashes={str(p.relative_to(r)):digest(p) for p in pairs}\nfiles=[];parents={}\nfor pair in pairs:\n for p in sorted(cache.glob(pair.stem+'_*.wl')):\n  relative=str(p.relative_to(r))\n  if relative not in protected:files.append(p);parents[relative]=str(pair.relative_to(r))\nassert files and len(files)==len(set(files))\nassert all(not p.is_symlink() and r in p.resolve().parents for p in files)\ninventory={str(p.relative_to(r)):{'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(p),'completed_pair':parents[str(p.relative_to(r))]} for p in files}\ngroups=[];group=[];n=0\nfor p in files:\n size=inventory[str(p.relative_to(r))]['bytes'];assert size<80*1024**2\n if group and n+size>80*1024**2:groups.append(group);group=[];n=0\n group.append(p);n+=size\nif group:groups.append(group)\nmanifest={'schema':'polarized-sidis-completed-pair-projection-archive-v1','channel':'Hgq','stage':'s05','archive_job_id':os.environ['JOB_ID'],'completed_pair_sha256':pairhashes,'protected_paths':sorted(protected),'files':inventory,'archives':[],'logical_bytes':sum(v['bytes'] for v in inventory.values()),'restore_base':str(r),'complete':False}\natomic(manifestpath,manifest)\nfor index,group in enumerate(groups,1):\n assert shutil.disk_usage(str(r)).free>2*1024**3+80*1024**2\n final=out/('s05_cache_part'+str(index).zfill(2)+'.tar.gz');temp=final.with_name(final.name+'.tmp')\n with tarfile.open(str(temp),'w:gz',compresslevel=1) as t:\n  for p in group:t.add(str(p),arcname=str(p.relative_to(r)),recursive=False)\n assert temp.stat().st_size<128*1024**2\n seen=set()\n with tarfile.open(str(temp),'r:gz') as t:\n  for member in t:\n   assert member.isfile() and member.name in inventory and member.name not in seen\n   h=hashlib.sha256();size=0\n   with t.extractfile(member) as f:\n    for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b);size+=len(b)\n   assert h.hexdigest()==inventory[member.name]['sha256'] and size==inventory[member.name]['bytes']\n   seen.add(member.name)\n assert seen=={str(p.relative_to(r)) for p in group}\n currentprotected=protected_paths()\n for p in group:\n  relative=str(p.relative_to(r))\n  assert relative not in currentprotected and digest(p)==inventory[relative]['sha256']\n  pair=parents[relative];assert digest(r/pair)==pairhashes[pair]\n temp.rename(final)\n archive={'file':str(final.relative_to(r)),'bytes':final.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(final)}\n manifest['archives'].append(archive)\n for p in group:manifest['files'][str(p.relative_to(r))]['archive']=archive['file']\n atomic(manifestpath,manifest)\n for p in group:p.unlink()\n print(json.dumps({'event':'VERIFIED_PROJECTION_ARCHIVE','archive':archive,'preserved_pairs':len(pairs),'removed_raw_bytes':sum(inventory[str(p.relative_to(r))]['bytes'] for p in group)}),flush=True)\nfor name,sha in pairhashes.items():assert digest(r/name)==sha\nassert all('archive' in v for v in {
  "command": [
    "python3",
    "-c",
    "from pathlib import Path\nimport os,json,hashlib,tarfile,subprocess,shutil,re,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET\nr=Path.cwd()\nassert os.environ.get('JOB_ID') and r.name=='polarized_SIDIS_20260917T063521Z'\ncache=r/'cache/s05/Hqg/a26ff6bda85fa1c70a7376a396436ddf9604decb38c24c812c356d7ac9ee8f45'\nout=r/'Hqg/s05_projection_archive_continuation_result';out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\nmanifestpath=out/'s05_cache_manifest.json'\nassert not manifestpath.exists() and not list(out.glob('s05_cache_part*.tar.gz*'))\ndef digest(p):\n h=hashlib.sha256()\n with p.open('rb') as f:\n  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b)\n return h.hexdigest()\ndef atomic(p,v):\n tmp=p.with_name(p.name+'.tmp');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+chr(10));assert json.loads(tmp.read_text())==v;tmp.replace(p)\ndef strings(v):\n if isinstance(v,str):yield v\n elif isinstance(v,dict):\n  for k,w in v.items():\n   yield k\n   for s in strings(w):yield s\n elif isinstance(v,list):\n  for w in v:\n   for s in strings(w):yield s\ndef protected_paths():\n protected={str((cache/'Real_1_5_P2_2.wl').relative_to(r))}\n for p in list((r/'common').glob('s05*.json'))+list((r/'.cluster').glob('*_job.json')):\n  for s in strings(json.loads(p.read_text())):\n   if s.startswith('cache/s05/Hqg/'):protected.add(s)\n return protected\nprotected=protected_paths()\npairs=sorted(p for p in cache.glob('Real*.wl') if re.fullmatch(r'Real[^_]*_[0-9]+_[0-9]+\\.wl',p.name))\nassert pairs\npairhashes={str(p.relative_to(r)):digest(p) for p in pairs}\nfiles=[];parents={}\nfor pair in pairs:\n for p in sorted(cache.glob(pair.stem+'_*.wl')):\n  relative=str(p.relative_to(r))\n  if relative not in protected:files.append(p);parents[relative]=str(pair.relative_to(r))\nassert files and len(files)==len(set(files))\nassert all(not p.is_symlink() and r in p.resolve().parents for p in files)\ninventory={str(p.relative_to(r)):{'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(p),'completed_pair':parents[str(p.relative_to(r))]} for p in files}\ngroups=[];group=[];n=0\nfor p in files:\n size=inventory[str(p.relative_to(r))]['bytes'];assert size<80*1024**2\n if group and n+size>80*1024**2:groups.append(group);group=[];n=0\n group.append(p);n+=size\nif group:groups.append(group)\nmanifest={'schema':'polarized-sidis-completed-pair-projection-archive-v1','channel':'Hqg','stage':'s05','archive_job_id':os.environ['JOB_ID'],'completed_pair_sha256':pairhashes,'protected_paths':sorted(protected),'files':inventory,'archives':[],'logical_bytes':sum(v['bytes'] for v in inventory.values()),'restore_base':str(r),'complete':False}\natomic(manifestpath,manifest)\nfor index,group in enumerate(groups,1):\n assert shutil.disk_usage(str(r)).free>2*1024**3+80*1024**2\n final=out/('s05_cache_part'+str(index).zfill(2)+'.tar.gz');temp=final.with_name(final.name+'.tmp')\n with tarfile.open(str(temp),'w:gz',compresslevel=1) as t:\n  for p in group:t.add(str(p),arcname=str(p.relative_to(r)),recursive=False)\n assert temp.stat().st_size<128*1024**2\n seen=set()\n with tarfile.open(str(temp),'r:gz') as t:\n  for member in t:\n   assert member.isfile() and member.name in inventory and member.name not in seen\n   h=hashlib.sha256();size=0\n   with t.extractfile(member) as f:\n    for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b);size+=len(b)\n   assert h.hexdigest()==inventory[member.name]['sha256'] and size==inventory[member.name]['bytes']\n   seen.add(member.name)\n assert seen=={str(p.relative_to(r)) for p in group}\n currentprotected=protected_paths()\n for p in group:\n  relative=str(p.relative_to(r))\n  assert relative not in currentprotected and digest(p)==inventory[relative]['sha256']\n  pair=parents[relative];assert digest(r/pair)==pairhashes[pair]\n temp.rename(final)\n archive={'file':str(final.relative_to(r)),'bytes':final.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(final)}\n manifest['archives'].append(archive)\n for p in group:manifest['files'][str(p.relative_to(r))]['archive']=archive['file']\n atomic(manifestpath,manifest)\n for p in group:p.unlink()\n print(json.dumps({'event':'VERIFIED_PROJECTION_ARCHIVE','archive':archive,'preserved_pairs':len(pairs),'removed_raw_bytes':sum(inventory[str(p.relative_to(r))]['bytes'] for p in group)}),flush=True)\nfor name,sha in pairhashes.items():assert digest(r/name)==sha\nassert all('archive' in v for v in inventory.values())\nmanifest['complete']=True;manifest['member_hashes_verified']=True;manifest['completed_pair_files_unchanged']=True\natomic(manifestpath,manifest)\nprint('PASS: s05_archive_completed_pair_projections',flush=True)\n"

v['job_id']=='14777388'\nfor n,h in v['result_sha256'].items():assert digest(r/n)==h,n\nlive=active();assert not any(n.startswith('pSIDIS_'+s+'_'+c+'_') for jid,n in live)\nfor jid,n in live:\n j=json.loads((r/'.cluster'/(n[len('pSIDIS_'):]+'_job.json')).read_text())\n assert not any(p.startswith(prefix) for p in j['reviewed_sha256']),(jid,prefix)\nmp=resultdir/(s+'_cache_manifest.json')\nassert not mp.exists() and not list(resultdir.glob(s+'_cache_part*.tar.gz*'))\nfiles=sorted(p for p in d.rglob('*') if files}\nrawbytes=sum(a['bytes'] for a in inventory.values())\nassert rawbytes<120*1024**2\nassert and total+size>part_limit:groups.append(group);group=[];total=0\n group.append(p);total+=size\nif group:groups.append(group)\nparts=[];seen=set()\nfor i,group in enumerate(groups,1):\n out=resultdir/(s+'_cache_part'+str(i).zfill(2)+'.tar.gz');temp=out.with_name(out.name+'.tmp')\n with tarfile.open(str(temp),'w:gz',compresslevel=1) as t:\n  for p in and member.name in inventory and member.name not in seen\n   h=hashlib.sha256();n=0\n   with t.extractfile(member) as f:\n    for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b);n+=len(b)\n   assert n==inventory[member.name]['bytes'] and h.hexdigest()==inventory[member.name]['sha256']\n   seen.add(member.name);inventory[member.name]['archive']=str(out.relative_to(r))\n temp.rename(out)\n parts.append({'file':str(out.relative_to(r)),'bytes':out.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(out)})\nassert seen==set(inventory)\nfor p in files:assert digest(p)==inventory[str(p.relative_to(r))]['sha256']\nassert not any(n.startswith('pSIDIS_'+s+'_'+c+'_') for jid,n in active())\nmanifest={'schema':'polarized-sidis-lossless-cache-archive-parts-v1','channel':c,'stage':s,'accepted_job_id':v['job_id'],'accepted_execution_sha256':digest(receiptpath),'accepted_result_sha256':v['result_sha256'],'archives':parts,'logical_bytes':rawbytes,'files':inventory,'member_hashes_verified':True,'restore_base':str(r)}\nmp.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+chr(10))\nfor {

    "from pathlib import Path\nimport os,json,hashlib,tarfile,subprocess,shutil,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET\nr=Path('/u/scratch/r/rushil/AI_Assisted_SIDIS/polarized_SIDIS_20260917T063521Z')\nc='Hgq';s='s08';prefixes=['cache/s08/Hgq/','cache/s08_targets/Hgq/','cache/s08_certified_denominator/Hgq/']\ndef digest(p):\n h=hashlib.sha256()\n with p.open('rb') as f:\n  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b)\n return h.hexdigest()\ndef active():\n rows=ET.fromstring(subprocess.check_output(['/u/systems/UGE8.6.4/bin/lx-amd64/qstat','-xml','-u','rushil'])).findall('.//job_list')\n return [(a.findtext('JB_job_number'),a.findtext('JB_name')) for a in rows if a.findtext('JB_name','').startswith('pSIDIS_') and a.findtext('JB_job_number')!=os.environ.get('JOB_ID')]\nresultdir=r/c/(s+'_cache_archive_result');resultdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True);receiptpath=r/c/(s+'_result')/(s+'_execution.json')\nv=json.loads(receiptpath.read_text());assert v['passed'] and v['job_id']=='14813688'\nassert digest(receiptpath)=='578dabcb5776d901f1308112f36fa6da0445bdc9bd90575a8086f15524785345'\nfinalpath=r/'Hgq/s12_result/s12_execution.json'\nassert digest(finalpath)=='d6b6ccca5a2dd83b7fb8575ba06282d62b3b7a4e786d06d43e2f0881092a38f1'\nfinal=json.loads(finalpath.read_text());assert final['passed'] and final['job_id']=='14814320'\nlive=active();assert not any(n.startswith('pSIDIS_'+s+'_'+c+'_') for jid,n in live)\nfor jid,n in live:\n j=json.loads((r/'.cluster'/(n[len('pSIDIS_'):]+'_job.json')).read_text())\n assert not any(any(p.startswith(prefix) for prefix in prefixes) for p in j['reviewed_sha256']),(jid,prefixes)\nmp=resultdir/(s+'_cache_manifest.json')\nassert not mp.exists() and not list(resultdir.glob(s+'_cache_part*.tar.gz*'))\nprotected=set()\nfor configuration in (r/'.cluster').glob('*_job.json'):\n protected.update(json.loads(configuration.read_text()).get('reviewed_sha256',{}))\nallfiles=sorted(p for prefix in prefixes for p in (r/prefix).rglob('*') if p.is_file())\nfiles=[p for p in allfiles if str(p.relative_to(r)) not in protected]\nprotected_files={str(p.relative_to(r)):digest(p) for p in allfiles if str(p.relative_to(r)) in protected}\nassert files and all(not p.is_symlink() and r in p.resolve().parents for p in files)\ninventory={str(p.relative_to(r)):{'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(p)} for p in files}\nrawbytes=sum(a['bytes'] for a in inventory.values())\nassert rawbytes<512*1024**2\nassert shutil.disk_usage(str(r)).free>2*1024**3+rawbytes\ngroups=[];group=[];total=0;part_limit=120*1024**2\nfor p in files:\n size=inventory[str(p.relative_to(r))]['bytes'];assert size<part_limit\n if group and total+size>part_limit:groups.append(group);group=[];total=0\n group.append(p);total+=size\nif group:groups.append(group)\nparts=[];seen=set()\nfor i,group in enumerate(groups,1):\n out=resultdir/(s+'_cache_part'+str(i).zfill(2)+'.tar.gz');temp=out.with_name(out.name+'.tmp')\n with tarfile.open(str(temp),'w:gz',compresslevel=1) as t:\n  for p in group:t.add(str(p),arcname=str(p.relative_to(r)),recursive=False)\n assert temp.stat().st_size<128*1024**2\n with tarfile.open(str(temp),'r:gz') as t:\n  for member in t:\n   assert member.isfile() and member.name in inventory and member.name not in seen\n   h=hashlib.sha256();n=0\n   with t.extractfile(member) as f:\n    for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b);n+=len(b)\n   assert n==inventory[member.name]['bytes'] and h.hexdigest()==inventory[member.name]['sha256']\n   seen.add(member.name);inventory[member.name]['archive']=str(out.relative_to(r))\n temp.rename(out)\n parts.append({'file':str(out.relative_to(r)),'bytes':out.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest(out)})\nassert seen==set(inventory)\nfor p in files:assert digest(p)==inventory[str(p.relative_to(r))]['sha256']\nassert not any(n.startswith('pSIDIS_'+s+'_'+c+'_') for jid,n in active())\nmanifest={'schema':'polarized-sidis-lossless-cache-archive-parts-v1','channel':c,'stage':s,'accepted_job_id':v['job_id'],'accepted_execution_sha256':digest(receiptpath),'accepted_result_sha256':v['result_sha256'],'archives':parts,'logical_bytes':rawbytes,'files':inventory,'member_hashes_verified':True,'restore_base':str(r),'protected_files_retained':protected_files,'cache_prefixes':prefixes}\nmp.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+chr(10))\n# {
  "command": [
    "python3",
    "-c",
    "from pathlib import Path\nimport os,json,hashlib,tarfile,shutil\nr=Path.cwd()\nassert os.environ.get('JOB_ID')\ncfg=json.loads((r/'common/s08_pair_mapping_inputs.json').read_text())\nmanifest=json.loads((r/'Hqqprime/s05_result/s05_cache_manifest.json').read_text())\ndef digest(p):\n h=hashlib.sha256()\n with p.open('rb') as f:\n  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024**2),b''):h.update(b)\n return h.hexdigest()\nfor archive in manifest['archives']:\n p=r/archive['file'];assert digest(p)==archive['sha256']\n with tarfile.open(str(p),'r:gz') as t:\n  for name in cfg['pair_files']:\n   if manifest['files'][name]['archive']!=archive['file']:continue\n   dst=r/name;assert r in dst.resolve().parents and not dst.is_symlink()\n   if dst.exists():assert digest(dst)==cfg['files'][name];continue\n   member=t.getmember(name);assert member.isfile() and member.size==manifest['files'][name]['bytes']\n   dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);tmp=dst.with_name(dst.name+'.restore.tmp')\n   with t.extractfile(member) as src,tmp.open('wb') as out:shutil.copyfileobj(src,out,1024**2)\n   assert digest(tmp)==cfg['files'][name];tmp.replace(dst)\nprint('PAIR_ARCHIVE_MEMBERS_RESTORED',len(cfg['pair_files']),flush=True)\nkernel='/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel'\nos.execv(kernel,[kernel,'-noinit','-noprompt','-script',str(r/'common/s08_check_pair_mapping.wls')])\n"

    "/u/local/apps/mathematica/13.1/Executables/WolframKernel",
    "-noinit",
    "-noprompt",
    "-run",
    "$HistoryLength=0;\nPrependTo[$Path,\"/u/home/r/rushil/.Mathematica/Applications\"];\n$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get[\"FeynCalc`\"];\ngate[name_,test_]:=If[!TrueQ[test],Print[\"FAIL: \",name];Quit[1]];\nSetAttributes[bounded,HoldFirst];bounded[v_,label_]:=MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[v,180,Print[\"FAIL: \",label,\" time\"];Quit[1]],2*1024^3,Print[\"FAIL: \",label,\" memory\"];Quit[1]];\nmapped=bounded[Get[FileNameJoin[{Directory[],\"Hqqprime\",\"s08_result\",\"s08_result.wl\"}]],\"accepted map read\"];\ngate[\"accepted complete coefficient map\",TrueQ[mapped[\"MappingAccepted\"]]&&TrueQ[mapped[\"ReductionCoverageComplete\"]]&&And@@Values[mapped[\"Checks\"]]];\ncomponent=mapped[\"Components\"][[7]];\ncoefficients=Select[component[\"ReducedCoefficients\"],#=!=0&]/.mapped[\"TransverseSubstitution\"];\nmaster=First[Keys[coefficients]];c=coefficients[master];\nregions=Get[FileNameJoin[{Directory[],\"common\",\"s06_result\",\"reference\",\"s15_result.wl\"}]]/.mapped[\"ScalarConventionRules\"];\nvalue=regions[\"OrdinaryMasters\"][master];\nPrint[\"ACTUAL_COMPONENT=\",InputForm[KeyTake[component,{\"Sector\",\"Kind\",\"Index\"}]]];\nPrint[\"ACTUAL_MASTER=\",InputForm[master]];\nPrint[\"COEFFICIENT_BYTES=\",ByteCount[c]];\nnum=Numerator[c];den=Denominator[c];\ngate[\"numerator and denominator polynomial in D\",PolynomialQ[num,D]&&PolynomialQ[den,D]];\nPrint[\"ACTUAL_COEFFICIENT_DENOMINATOR=\",InputForm[den]];\nPrint[\"NUMERATOR_D_DEGREE=\",Exponent[num,D]];\nPrint[\"DENOMINATOR_D_DEGREE=\",Exponent[den,D]];\nPrint[\"DENOMINATOR_AT_D4=\",InputForm[den/.D->4]];\nnc=bounded[CoefficientList[num,D],\"numerator D coefficients\"];\ndc=bounded[CoefficientList[den,D],\"denominator D coefficients\"];\ngate[\"D coefficient reconstruction\",bounded[Expand[num-Sum[nc[[j]]D^(j-1),{j,Length[nc]}]]===0&&Expand[den-Sum[dc[[j]]D^(j-1),{j,Length[dc]}]]===0,\"D reconstruction\"]];\nPrint[\"NUMERATOR_D_COEFFICIENT_BYTES=\",ByteCount/@nc];\nPrint[\"DENOMINATOR_D_COEFFICIENTS=\",InputForm[dc]];\nPrint[\"MASTER_SERIES_METADATA=\",InputForm[Cases[value,q_SeriesData:>{q[[1]],q[[2]],q[[4]],q[[5]],q[[6]]},{0,Infinity}]]];\nPrint[\"ACTUAL_MASTER_VALUE=\",InputForm[value]];\nPrint[\"PASS: s12_read_integration_input\"];Quit[0];"
